desc:
🖥️🎮📱 Play Beyond Nen on PC, console, and mobile!

⚔️ Think you’ve got what it takes to become a Hunter? Your adventure begins on Whale Island. Venture off the trail in search of hidden treasure, or gather your crew and fight your way to the boss at Volcanic Domain.

🌀 Discover your Nen affinity and pair your abilities with a weapon that fits the way you fight. Test your skills against rival teams in the Gladiator arena, then take on the Hunter Exam when you’re ready. Pass it to earn your license and unlock Hunter missions!

👍 Like the game for free codes and rewards!
👥 Join our community server for game updates, announcements, and exclusive rewards!
